documents.text:
Original publication record: the Official Journal lists 12 July 2024. The act names the European Parliament and Council as its institutions.
Original phased exceptions: Chapters I and II start 2 February 2025; specified governance and general-purpose provisions start 2 August 2025 except Article 101; Article 6(1) and corresponding duties start 2 August 2027.
Version warning: the original record is marked changed and links a consolidated version dated 27 July 2026; current obligations were not assessed.
